keying_strategy: Every key in variables matches the raw Phase7_complete / source row column name exactly. Do not rename runtime property payload keys. Use canonical_name only as metadata.
scope: Phase7_complete columns present in the current property row provided by the user
runtime_rule: At runtime pass one property row with raw keys plus only the matching dictionary subset for the target section.
sentiment_note: Resident sentiment fields are external to Phase7_complete and should be maintained in a separate sentiment dictionary/payload. This dictionary is for Phase7/property-row columns only.

broker_name.business_meaning: Broker or intermediary associated with the opportunity.
broker_name.missing_value_behavior: Allow null; render 'Not available' in deal header if missing.

address.missing_value_behavior: Required for deal header; allow partial if some components missing.

city.business_meaning: City where the property is located.

state.business_meaning: State abbreviation where the property is located.

zip.business_meaning: Postal code for the property location.

Property Vintage.business_meaning: Construction year / vintage of the property.
Property Vintage.missing_value_behavior: Tier 1; if missing, the report should not rely on vintage as a supporting rationale and verdict confidence drops materially.

Unit Size.business_meaning: Total number of units in the property. Raw column name is misleading; in Phase7/report usage this is total units, not apartment size.
Unit Size.missing_value_behavior: If missing, score null and note a confidence caveat.
Unit Size.notes: Treat as unit count in reporting.

Deal Size ($).business_meaning: Raw deal-size-related input from Phase7. In practice this appears to be asking price per unit, while rubric scoring may use an implied total deal size derived from this value and Unit Size.
Deal Size ($).missing_value_behavior: If missing or unparsable, score null and note confidence caveat.
Deal Size ($).notes: Before scoring, confirm whether this raw value should be used directly or transformed into implied total deal size.

Market Scale.business_meaning: Scale of existing ownership / presence in the same market.
Market Scale.missing_value_behavior: Tier 2; include in missing-score summary but do not block verdict.

Ceiling Height.business_meaning: Ceiling-height band or inferred listing text.
Ceiling Height.missing_value_behavior: If unknown, treat as 'Not available' and score 0.
Ceiling Height.notes: Current raw examples mix missingness and inference.

Swimming Pool.business_meaning: Whether the property includes a swimming pool.
Swimming Pool.missing_value_behavior: If missing, keep unknown; do not assume No.

Fitness Center.business_meaning: Whether the property includes a fitness center.
Fitness Center.missing_value_behavior: If missing, keep unknown; do not assume No.

Unit Types & Square Footage.business_meaning: Raw unit-mix and square-footage text from listing source.
Unit Types & Square Footage.missing_value_behavior: If parse fails, keep raw text for audit.
Unit Types & Square Footage.notes: Primary raw source for deriving 1BR size band.

Patio.notes: Transcript indicates this family of scrape fields is unreliable and may be removed.

Balcony.notes: Transcript indicates this family of scrape fields is unreliable and may be removed.

Yard.notes: Transcript indicates this family of scrape fields is unreliable and may be removed.

2nd Bath for 2+ Bedroom Units.business_meaning: Whether 2BR+ units have a second bath.

Apartment Size.business_meaning: Helper label such as Small / Medium / Large. Do not treat as the authoritative scoring basis unless workflow explicitly maps it; scoring is defined on 1BR square footage bands.
Apartment Size.missing_value_behavior: If helper label exists but 1BR sqft cannot be parsed, treat scoring basis as unresolved.
Apartment Size.notes: Use Unit Types & Square Footage to derive the actual scoring band where possible.

Transit Score.missing_value_behavior: Tier 1; if missing, maximum verdict is Conditional Go.

Bike Score.notes: Raw field exists, but rubric is not finalized.

Sound Score.notes: High score is treated as favorable in the current report logic.

Great Schools Rating (Score).business_meaning: Composite GreatSchools average derived from nearby schools.
Great Schools Rating (Score).missing_value_behavior: If missing, note in location panel and data log.

Retail - Starbucks.business_meaning: Distance to nearest Starbucks as a convenience proxy.
Retail - Starbucks.missing_value_behavior: If missing, omit from convenience interpretation.

Undesirable Retail.business_meaning: Distance to nearest undesirable retail / adverse retail adjacency.
Undesirable Retail.missing_value_behavior: If missing, note location confidence caveat.
Undesirable Retail.notes: Current Phase7/report examples suggest a stronger penalty than the supplied rubric table for some values.

Retail - National Cluster.business_meaning: Distance to nearest national retail cluster.
Retail - National Cluster.missing_value_behavior: If missing, omit from retail-strength interpretation.

Retail - National Grocer.business_meaning: Distance to nearest national grocer anchor.
Retail - National Grocer.missing_value_behavior: If missing, omit from retail-strength interpretation.

Census Block.business_meaning: Census block identifier / local block value.

Census Tract.business_meaning: Census tract identifier used for demographic context.

Census County.business_meaning: County name for the property geography.

Justice Map - Income Range.business_meaning: Income-range band for the mapped geography.
Justice Map - Income Range.missing_value_behavior: If missing, demographic context becomes less descriptive.
Justice Map - Income Range.notes: Context field; not directly scored in supplied rubric.

Median Income.business_meaning: Median household income for the selected geography.
Median Income.missing_value_behavior: Tier 1; if missing, verdict quality is materially weakened.

Population.business_meaning: Population count for the selected geography.
Population.missing_value_behavior: If missing, demographic table is incomplete.

Population Density.business_meaning: Population density used as a demand/liquidity proxy in the current model.
Population Density.missing_value_behavior: If missing, demographic-demand assessment becomes incomplete.
Population Density.notes: Phase7 has a rubric score column for this field, but the corresponding lookup table was not included in the supplied rubric list.

Justice Map - Surrounding.missing_value_behavior: If missing, note in demographic context only.
Justice Map - Surrounding.notes: Phase7 has a rubric score column for this field, but the corresponding lookup table was not included in the supplied rubric list.

Heatmap Score.notes: Current Phase7 example shows raw values and score contributions that do not fully align with the supplied rubric table.

Modified Heatmap Score.notes: Raw values may exceed 100 while rubric is banded; treat banding logic as model-defined.

Data Inserted Timestamp.business_meaning: Timestamp when the Phase7 row was created/persisted.

Great Schools Data.business_meaning: Raw text listing nearby schools, level codes, ratings, and distances.
Great Schools Data.missing_value_behavior: If missing, school detail panel becomes unavailable.
Great Schools Data.notes: Raw detail field for school panel.

Relaxed Fields Used.business_meaning: Fields relaxed or tolerated during extraction/scoring.

Rubric - Location Score.missing_value_behavior: Expected null until source and rubric are finalized.
